blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The prosecution in former President Rodrigo Duterte’s crimes against humanity case before the International Criminal Court (ICC) has removed one drug-related killing from its trial brief, following the chamber’s directive. Based on a document released publicly on Wednesday, the prosecution said it removed all references to Incident 57 from its trial brief and replaced them with redacted information — blacked out in the publicly available document due to confidentiality — to “retain cross-references.” READ: ICC rejects defense’s motion to have prosecution open a new case file “References to Incident 57 have also been removed from Annexes C.1 and […]...
